items: Selection Committee Composition: Prime Minister (Head), Speaker of Lok Sabha, Deputy Chairman of Rajya Sabha, Leaders of Opposition in both Houses of Parliament, and Union Home Minister.
2019 Amendment Impact: Tenure reduced from 5 years to 3 years (up to 70 years of age), with eligibility for reappointment restored.
Removal Process: Can be removed by the President only on the grounds of proven misbehaviour or incapacity after an inquiry by the Supreme Court.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NHRC is a statutory multi-member body consisting of a Chairperson, 5 full-time members, and 7 ex-officio members.
The Chairperson must be a retired Chief Justice of India or a retired Judge of the Supreme Court as per the 2019 Amendment.
Among the five full-time members, at least one must be a woman with practical experience in human rights.
Ex-officio members include heads of National Commissions for Minorities, SCs, STs, Women, BCs, Protection of Child Rights, and Persons with Disabilities.
Appointments are made by the President on the recommendation of a six-member selection committee headed by the Prime Minister.
